label: Bible Study
prompt: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for _____.
verse: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
note: Friends love at all times — and brothers are born for the hard days.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the _____ of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
verse: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
note: God doesn't just call us — He calls us into fellowship with His Son, and He's faithful to see it through.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his _____.
verse: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
note: Jacob's final act of faith: blessing Joseph's two sons, and worshipping as he leaned on the top of his staff.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your _____ are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
verse: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
note: Forty years in the desert and not one worn-out cloak or sandal — God's quiet wardrobe miracle.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: _____ themselves to be wise, they became fools,
verse: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
note: The great irony in eight words: 'Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools.'
